ValidationRule.description: Whenever a Request is in the status of On hold - Information needed/Awaiting action from Stakeholder, the GCCS Request Pending With is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Sales_Support_Request__c'))), OR( ISPICKVAL(Request_Status__c, "On hold - Information needed"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Status__c, "Awaiting action from Stakeholder") ), ISBLANK(GCCS_Request_Pending_With__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Request is On Hold or Awaiting Action please confirm who it is Pending with.
